zh.stem: 项目需求频繁变化，团队应采用哪种方式？

options.text: 采用迭代方式持续调整
暂停项目等待需求稳定

en.stem: Project requirements change frequently. Which approach should the team use?

options.text: Use an iterative approach and adjust continuously
Pause the project until requirements stabilize
Let only the project manager decide

zh.short: 需求频繁变化时，应采用迭代和持续反馈。
zh.detailed: 迭代方式允许团队根据反馈持续调整范围和优先级。
zh.incorrect: 请重新关注题目中的需求变化频率。
zh.general: 迭代和持续反馈更适合变化频繁的环境。

en.short: Frequent change calls for iteration and continuous feedback.
en.detailed: An iterative approach lets the team adjust scope and priorities using feedback.
en.incorrect: Focus again on how frequently the requirements change.
en.general: Iteration and continuous feedback fit a rapidly changing environment.
